RunSynchronousCommand.Path: cmd.exe /c ">>"X:\diskpart.txt" (echo:SELECT DISK=0&echo:CLEAN&echo:CONVERT GPT&echo:CREATE PARTITION EFI SIZE=300&echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=FAT32 LABEL=^"System^"&echo:ASSIGN LETTER=S&echo:CREATE PARTITION MSR SIZE=16&echo:CREATE PARTITION PRIMARY)"

cmd.exe /c ">>"X:\diskpart.txt" (echo:SHRINK MINIMUM=1000&echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=NTFS LABEL=^"Windows^"&echo:ASSIGN LETTER=W&echo:CREATE PARTITION PRIMARY&echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=NTFS LABEL=^"Recovery^"&echo:ASSIGN LETTER=R)"
cmd.exe /c "diskpart.exe /s "X:\diskpart.txt" >>"X:\diskpart.log" || ( type "X:\diskpart.log" & echo diskpart encountered an error. & pause & exit /b 1 )"

Extensions.File: @echo off :: SetupComplete.cmd echo [%date% %time%] Attente 15s... >> C:\Windows\Setup\Logs\SetupComplete.log timeout /t 15 /nobreak >nul echo Execution de PostInstall.ps1 >> C:\Windows\Setup\Logs\SetupComplete.log powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Deploy\PostInstall.ps1" exit /b 0

Remove-Item 'C:\Deploy' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Remove-Item 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts' -Exclude CleanupPostInstall.ps1 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Start-Process -FilePath "schtasks.exe" -ArgumentList "/Delete", "/TN", "CleanupPostInstall", "/F" -NoNewWindow -Wait
